e.title: The Fair Pricing Playbook
e.summary: 算法定价负责任 AI 框架（CC BY 4.0，Zenodo DOI）：公平定义/模型设计/福利评估/部署后审计四步
e.body: The Fair Pricing Playbook 是算法定价负责任 AI 的实用框架（CC BY 4.0，Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20879782）：四个关联步骤覆盖公平定义、模型设计、福利评估与部署后审计，附四个案例研究提供实现深度。对 RIAA：保险定价公平性（歧视审计）的系统化方法论。与 [[insurance-fairness]]（burning-cost 代理歧视审计）、[[insurance-fair-longterm]]（长期险公平）、[[insurance-optimise]]（FCA ENBP 约束优化）互补。关联 [[insurance-governance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。

e.summary_en: Practical framework for Responsible AI in algorithmic pricing (CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI): four linked steps — fairness definition, model design, welfare assessment, post-deployment audit
e.summary_hk: 算法定價負責任 AI 框架（CC BY 4.0，Zenodo DOI）：公平定義/模型設計/福利評估/部署後審計四步
e.body_en: The Fair Pricing Playbook is a practical framework for Responsible AI in algorithmic pricing (CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20879782): four linked steps covering fairness definition, model design, welfare assessment and post-deployment audit, with four case studies providing implementation depth. For RIAA: a systematic methodology for pricing fairness (discrimination audit). Complements [[insurance-fairness]] (burning-cost proxy-discrimination audit), [[insurance-fair-longterm]] (long-term fairness) and [[insurance-optimise]] (FCA ENBP constrained optimisation). Related: [[insurance-governance]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: The Fair Pricing Playbook 是算法定價負責任 AI 的實用框架（CC BY 4.0，Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20879782）：四個關聯步驟覆蓋公平定義、模型設計、福利評估與部署後審計，附四個案例研究提供實現深度。對 RIAA：保險定價公平性（歧視審計）的系統化方法論。與 [[insurance-fairness]]（burning-cost 代理歧視審計）、[[insurance-fair-longterm]]（長期險公平）、[[insurance-optimise]]（FCA ENBP 約束優化）互補。關聯 [[insurance-governance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
